text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while training was underway for 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
So that's Narita Brian...! Even the look 
on her face is built different...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Setting the record for the most GⅠ wins 
isn't just a dream! To think an Umamusume 
like this was born in our era...!"

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec, did you hear about that!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...How noisy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since it was an open training session on 
this day, the stands were packed with 
reporters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the reporters are certainly 
restless. The commotion is louder than 
usual, reaching all the way over here—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, is that for real!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, seems so. Until I heard this, I 
honestly thought Brian had no real 
competition.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Press Crew
text_block_list.text: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I see. To sum it all up, for the 
upcoming Autumn Tenno Sho—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes, I will run.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: O-Oguri Cap-san?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fans
text_block_list.text: Ready, and, Eau Greene!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Y-You guys. We're at the academy, you 
know. That nickname is embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
...W-What is the meaning of this? To have 
all the main contenders for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) gathered so suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
We've just gotta ask her directly! Oguri 
Cap-san, what made you decide to run in 
this race?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is one of the 
titles I really want, after all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Well then, what about you, Narita 
Brian-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I was told that if I seek strength, I 
should enter the race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Seeking strength, you've set your 
sights on the Tenno Sho (Autumn), have 
you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
All the more reason we can't afford to 
lose.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, you once 
mentioned at the URA Awards ceremony that 
you "would compete for the very pinnacle."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Is something the matter with that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is one of the peaks 
I wish to attain.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"As a challenger, and as someone who 
likewise seeks strength, I will not back 
down."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A rivalry declaration straight from Oguri 
Cap, huh? Even Brian might not be able to 
win this one.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
This is basically the clash to decide the 
absolute strongest...! Things are gonna 
get wild in this Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...To think I would be restrained to this 
extent.
choice_data_list:
It just shows how much attention is on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So that is the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. Aside from the 'Tenno Sho 
(Autumn),' what else makes up the Autumn 
Senior Triple Crown?"
choice_data_list:
Anything other than the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup and Arima Kinen... Both are 
renowned big races.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Please register me for that, then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is one of the peaks 
I wish to attain.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"As a challenger, and as someone who 
likewise seeks strength, I will not back 
down."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... For someone so formidable that they 
can project such fierce fighting spirit to 
call themselves a mere "challenger"...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I want to brace myself for this. No 
matter what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave the rest to you. I'm going to 
make up for what I fell short on today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having said only that, Narita Brian 
promptly started running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She must have been unable to hold back 
her feelings. As I took out my stopwatch 
and prepared to time her..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me. Is what you just said true?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is it confirmed that Brian will run in the 
Fall Senior Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If it's at the end of the year, she might 
make it in time.
choice_data_list: Will you make it in time?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Pay it no mind, I was just talking 
to myself. I wholeheartedly wish you all 
the best of luck.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And hopefully, our best efforts will bear 
fruit as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Autumn Senior Triple Crown begins with 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn). The curtain was 
about to rise on a period of massive 
upheaval.
